disambiguation: Not a game piece hider; it hides checklist items based on their completion status or custom markers.
intentEvidence: Hide completed and custom-status checklist items in Obsidian without changing your notes.
problem: Users often want to hide completed or specific custom checklist items to keep notes clean without deleting the original task data.

relations.evidence: Based on heliostatic/completed-task-display by Ben Lee-Cohen.

summary: Hides or shows completed and custom-status checklist items in Obsidian without altering the original note content.
